segments.text: Ok so this is the Multimodal Attachments page for Google Antigravity on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.

This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. After sending the prompt, the composer clears but nothing shows up, and there's a red text error on load.
So basically, you should get an answer about the photo, but the quick start has no message list, so nothing ever shows, plus that red error.
So yeah, this is the issue, kindly fix it.
